request: Two ledger rows, or two findings rows, must not carry the same id: the checker has to refuse the second one, naming its line and the row that already holds the id, because a citation that names the id could otherwise point at either row.

defects.description: Own-history fix 6332c4f125 (2026-09-15): fix(plan): the checker refuses two rows carrying one id
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
